# Feature: account-core
## Purpose
Provide account data.
## User outcome
People can see their safe account profile.
## Scope and non-goals
Account retrieval only.
## Positive flow
Request an existing account and see its profile.
## Negative and recovery flow
An unknown account produces a clear not-found result.
## User inputs and visible outcomes
The person identifies an account and receives its safe profile.
## Done outcomes
### DC-01 Account loads
Given an account, when requested, then its safe profile returns.
## Subjective user-test questions
(none)
## Applicable principles
(none identified)
